scope.test: Seed: Undo and Redo restore and reapply a GPU color change

trigger: The Undo/Redo pixel assertion failed after the render-revision synchronization repair; the test observed a new render revision but the resulting framebuffer did not equal the previously captured edited frame.
propagationPath: settings state update -> React commit -> passive useEffect(scheduleRender) -> requestAnimationFrame callback closing over prior settings; a pending RAF can execute before the passive effect cancels it, causing a render revision to be attributed to the wrong settings state.
violatedInvariant: Every observable render-completion revision used by browser evidence must correspond to the latest committed Seed render settings, never to a stale closure captured before the state transition.
observableSymptom: Chromium FAST shard-2 failed exact edited-frame equality on redo while the same run had 10 other Seed tests passing and no console/page/request failures.

evidence.failure: Expected true, received false at tests/seed.spec.ts:88 after waitForGpuRender detected revision change
evidence.webglCompletion: SeedGLEngine.render() already calls gl.finish() and gl.getError() before the revision marker; therefore GPU command completion alone does not explain the mismatch.

repairPlan.mechanism: Move render-setting ownership to a synchronously updated ref changed by commit/undo/redo/image-load paths; make scheduleRender stable and read the latest committed settings inside RAF instead of closing over React state.
repairPlan.regression: Retain the existing exact pixel Undo/Redo assertion plus render-revision synchronization; pre-repair failure is the current run 34309248825.

verificationPlan: Certification on the exact resulting main SHA
